_about: SEED list of always-flag interaction pairs, modelled on the ONC high-priority drug-drug interaction list. Owner: B. Every rule starts verified=false: check each pair against the paper before the demo and flip it to true. Summaries are in our own words.

source.title: High-priority drug-drug interactions for use in electronic health records
source.citation: Phansalkar S, et al. J Am Med Inform Assoc. 2012;19(5):735-743. doi:10.1136/amiajnl-2011-000612
